Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting water treatment facilities' systems
Remote access introduction of ransomware onto wastewater SCADA computer
Compromise of files within system by ransomware
Impacted Systems: Maine-based WWS facility wastewater SCADA computer
Attack Vector: Ransomware variant in system for about a month
Discoverer: U.S. government agencies (CISA, FBI, EPA, NSA)
